# NameLoop

> Grow your product. Outbound that books. Inbound that compounds.

NameLoop is a founder growth platform at https://nameloop.vercel.app. It runs a dual-engine growth loop — outbound email plus inbound social content — so founders can grow without a dedicated GTM team.

## Who it's for

- Solo founders and small teams with an early-stage or growing product
- B2B, B2C, D2C, marketplace, and B2B2C businesses
- Founders who want email outreach and content marketing aimed at the same buyer, with approvals before anything goes out

## What NameLoop does

- Reads your product URL and sketches who might buy (ICP)
- Finds leads, verifies emails, and sends outreach in daily caps (Gmail and Resend)
- Pauses or flags when bounce rates look bad; stops a lead when they reply
- Drafts posts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and other channels on a content calendar
- Surfaces angles from what's working in your niche; next week's drafts can start from winners
- Suggests paid ad boosts on Meta and Google — ad spend is billed by those platforms, not NameLoop
- Founder approves drafts; nothing sends or posts without approval (unless you enable autopilot per channel)

## Pricing (USD)

- **Starter** — $10/month (about $8/month billed annually): 3 channels, 500 emails/month, 30 posts/month, 1 seat
- **Growth** — $50/month (about $40/month billed annually): 6 channels, 2,500 emails/month, 120 posts/month, 3 seats, ad ideas
- **Enterprise** — custom limits, seats, SSO/security review, priority support, assisted onboarding (contact via site)

Ad platform spend is not included in subscription pricing.

## Positioning

NameLoop is not an AI SDR that optimizes for blast volume, and it is not a social scheduler alone. It is the growth loop founders run: outbound that books meetings, inbound that compounds — with limits, approvals, and replies staying with the founder.
